cases.purpose: Check combined and separate list-query options and independently decode sparse mask and list results for one owned child.
cases.oracle: Kernel sched_getaffinity and upstream taskset in the locked VM image.
cases.comparison: Validate exact PID and affinity prefixes, decode both representations independently, and compare them to the kernel's sparse affinity set.
cases.script:
/usr/bin/sleep 20 & child=$!
trap 'kill -KILL "$child" 2>/dev/null; wait "$child" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,sys;os.sched_setaffinity(int(sys.argv[1]),{0,2,3})' "$child" || exit 90
mask=$(taskset -p "$child") || exit 91
list=$(taskset -cp "$child") || exit 92
separate=$(taskset -c -p "$child") || exit 93
/usr/bin/python3 - "$child" "$mask" "$list" "$separate" <<'CHECK'
import os, sys
pid = int(sys.argv[1])
prefix = "pid %d's current affinity " % pid
mask, listing, separate = sys.argv[2:]
assert mask.startswith(prefix + 'mask: '), mask
assert listing.startswith(prefix + 'list: '), listing
assert listing == separate, (listing, separate)
maskbits = int(mask[len(prefix + 'mask: '):], 16)
maskset = {i for i in range(maskbits.bit_length()) if maskbits & (1 << i)}
listset = set()
for item in listing[len(prefix + 'list: '):].split(','):
    bounds = [int(n) for n in item.split('-')]
    assert len(bounds) in (1, 2) and bounds[0] <= bounds[-1], item
    listset.update(range(bounds[0], bounds[-1] + 1))
assert maskset == listset == os.sched_getaffinity(pid) == {0, 2, 3}, (maskset, listset)
print('query encodings agree: 0,2-3')
CHECK
